“One never knows the way of one’s return, if one ever returns,” he enunciated pessimistically. Elated by the pearl of wisdom he had dropped, he essayed another. “Three hundred in hand is better than three million in the bottom of a well we may never see again.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u011-r0036", "tag": "p", "text": "“Some one must descend into the well,” spoke Rafael, testing the braided rope with his weight. “See! The riata is strong. We will lower a man by it. Who is the brave one who will go down?”", "sha256": "082c391d1715caf9aac29b97b2d634237a78d118b0fc38e2af64dd0c7f52a1fd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[839]", "source_html": "

“Some one must descend into the well,” spoke Rafael, testing the braided rope with his weight. “See! The riata is strong. We will lower a man by it. Who is the brave one who will go down?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u011-r0037", "tag": "p", "text": "“I,” said Vicente. “I will be the brave one to go down——”", "sha256": "cff28bb1d9665ec5552617368a14ad69485f7cee8132963753ae207f1bef36dd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[840]", "source_html": "

“I,” said Vicente. “I will be the brave one to go down——”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u011-r0038", "tag": "p", "text": "“And steal half that you find,” Rafael uttered his instant suspicion. “If you go down, first must you count over to us the pesos you already possess. Then, when you come up, we can search you for all you have found. After that, when we have divided equitably, will your other pesos be returned to you.”", "sha256": "cc63bfd913aa8c8a3c4d2c92c65f286f893dbd6b5d19c7cc46c1cbf462b87a7c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[841]", "source_html": "

“And steal half that you find,” Rafael uttered his instant suspicion. “If you go down, first must you count over to us the pesos you already possess. Then, when you come up, we can search you for all you have found. After that, when we have divided equitably, will your other pesos be returned to you.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u011-r0039", "tag": "p", "text": "“Then will I not go down for comrades who have no trust in me,” Vicente said stubbornly. “Here, beside the well, I am as wealthy as any of you. Then why should I go down? I have heard of men dying in the bottom of wells.”", "sha256": "db1d20dbcac10b67850d6d293faeb29ce43b5e2ab30a68785bb30a5b355a78e7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[842]", "source_html": "

“Then will I not go down for comrades who have no 91trust in me,” Vicente said stubbornly. “Here, beside the well, I am as wealthy as any of you. Then why should I go down? I have heard of men dying in the bottom of wells.”

“In God’s name go down!” stormed the Jefe. “Haste! Haste!”

“I am too fat, the rope is not strong, and I shall not go down,” said Vicente.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u011-r0042", "tag": "p", "text": "All looked to Augustino, the silent one, who had already spoken more than he was accustomed to speak in a week.", "sha256": "72e4f160a2953ca7bbe61d4e63fc8f3f27e4f9c8dcd43b76d5a49d548d459671", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[845]", "source_html": "

All looked to Augustino, the silent one, who had already spoken more than he was accustomed to speak in a week.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u011-r0043", "tag": "p", "text": "“Guillermo is the thinnest and lightest,” said Augustino.", "sha256": "d6832b3f28ec17ed236c6182928e49f22348686c0a9a68954fcb26239e22d1ff", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[846]", "source_html": "

“Guillermo is the thinnest and lightest,” said Augustino.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u011-r0044", "tag": "p", "text": "“Guillermo will go down!” the rest chorused.", "sha256": "1e0bf72fdf6105c42d8c670216b0ce272ab3d78e84237bd3ade32c5e2799429c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[847]", "source_html": "

“Guillermo will go down!” the rest chorused.

But Guillermo, glaring apprehensively at the mouth of the well, backed away, shaking his head and crossing himself.

“Not for the sacred treasure in the secret city of the Mayas,” he muttered.
